root.label: Ceuta migrant surge and Spanish border response

events.label: Ceuta migrant surge and Spanish border response

slots.name: death toll
slots.sentence: Mr. Sánchez’s reaction to the Ceuta crisis, which Spain said had left more than 70 migrants dead, has highlighted that he has a more complex approach to migration than either Mr. Sánchez’s left-wing supporters or right-wing critics like to acknowledge.

slots.name: border control status
slots.sentence: “In less than 48 hours, my government has succeeded in fully restoring control over the border,” Mr. Sánchez wrote on Saturday in a response to criticism from partners in the European Union.

events.label: Police clear improvised migrant camp in Ceuta

slots.name: camp population
slots.sentence: It was not until last Sunday that police cleared an improvised camp where around 3,000 people had been living.
